summary: Steam Items reports an app hidden from anonymous store requests with its own message (`steam: app <id> is hidden from anonymous store requests (age or region gate); its store record and demo state are unknown`) while still satisfying errors.Is for both ErrAppHidden and ErrAppNotFound.
reason: ErrAppHidden used to be fmt.Errorf("%w: hidden...", ErrAppNotFound), so its text inherited ErrAppNotFound's "no Steam app matched the title" and `steam app 1245690` reported a found-but-gated app as a title mismatch. A hiddenAppError sentinel with Is(target) == (target == ErrAppNotFound) keeps not-found handling and exit code 3 without reusing the wrong wording.
validated_outcome: Offline test TestSteamAppHiddenMessageIsNotTitleMatch passes: the Item error contains "is hidden from anonymous store requests", does not contain "matched the title", and errors.Is is true for both sentinels.
